# Conversation Tree Script for Game Rooms (2026-02-10 12:15Z)

_**User (2026-02-10 12:40Z)**_

Id like you to create a script (and put it in src/) that is able to produce conversation trees for any room in the game, with all the information we know about conversations in the game. It should put all the roots at the top level then construct the hierarchy with the different dialgo lines and choices. I want to put emphasis on the dialog actions: I want to use this as a reference to implement the different actions.

Construct the tree first then put an additional action with all the action codes to be covered.

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/src/extract_conversation_tree.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/src/extract_conversation_tree.py)",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract Conversation Tree with Action Emphasis\n===============================================\n\nProduces conversation trees for any room in the game with emphasis on action codes.\nTrees show hierarchical structure with proper choice detection and all action triggers.\n\nUsage:\n    python3 src/extract_conversation_tree.py &lt;room_number&gt;\n    python3 src/extract_conversation_tree.py 22\n\nOutput format matches room22_tree.txt with tree-drawing characters and action annotations.\nIncludes action summary section at the end for implementation reference.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# CONTROL CODES\n# ============================================================================\n\nCTRL_SPEAKER = 0x08           # Speaker marker (followed by speaker ID)\nCTRL_ALFRED_ID = 0x0D         # Alfred's speaker ID\nCTRL_END_TEXT = 0xFD          # End of text line\nCTRL_TEXT_TERM = 0xFC         # Alternative text terminator\nCTRL_CHOICE_ONCE = 0xFB       # One-time choice (disabled after selection)\nCTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT = 0xF1     # Repeatable choice\nCTRL_DISABLED = 0xFA          # Disabled choice marker (replaces 0x08)\nCTRL_PAGE_BREAK = 0xF9        # Long text page break\nCTRL_ACTION = 0xF8            # Action trigger (followed by 2-byte action ID)\nCTRL_END_BRANCH = 0xF7        # End conversation branch\nCTRL_LINE_CONTINUE = 0xF6     # Line continuation\nCTRL_END_CONV_ALT = 0xF5      # Alternative end marker\nCTRL_ROOT_PRIMARY = 0xFE      # Primary conversation root\nCTRL_END_CONV = 0xF4          # End conversation\nCTRL_GO_BACK = 0xF0           # Return to previous menu\nCTRL_ALT_END = 0xEB           # Another alternative end marker\nCTRL_DESC_START = 0xFF        # Description block start\n\n# Spanish character encoding\nSPANISH_CHARS = {\n    0x80: 'ñ', 0x81: 'í', 0x82: '¡', 0x83: '¿', 0x84: 'ú',\n    0x7B: 'á', 0x7C: 'é', 0x7D: 'í', 0x7E: 'ó', 0x7F: 'ú',\n}\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# DATA STRUCTURES\n# ============================================================================\n\nclass ConversationNode:\n    \"\"\"Node in the conversation tree\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, node_type: str):\n        self.node_type = node_type  # 'root', 'npc', 'choice', 'auto'\n        self.text: str = \"\"\n        self.speaker: str = \"\"\n        self.choice_type: Optional[str] = None  # 'FB', 'F1', 'FA'\n        self.choice_index: Optional[int] = None\n        self.action_code: Optional[int] = None\n        self.has_go_back: bool = False\n        self.has_f4_end: bool = False\n        self.has_f7_branch: bool = False\n        self.children: List['ConversationNode'] = []\n        self.root_index: Optional[int] = None  # For FE roots\n        \n    def __repr__(self):\n        return f\"&lt;{self.node_type}: {self.text[:30]}... children={len(self.children)}&gt;\"\n\n\nclass ConversationTree:\n    \"\"\"Complete conversation tree for a room\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, room_num: int):\n        self.room_num = room_num\n        self.roots: List[ConversationNode] = []\n        self.actions_found: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []  # (action_id, context)\n        self.descriptions: List[str] = []\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# FILE READING UTILITIES\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef read_room_pair(data: bytes, room_num: int, pair_num: int) -&gt; Optional[bytes]:\n    \"\"\"Read a specific data pair from a room\"\"\"\n    room_offset = room_num * 104  # 13 pairs × 8 bytes\n    pair_offset_pos = room_offset + (pair_num * 8)\n    \n    if pair_offset_pos + 8 &gt; len(data):\n        return None\n    \n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pair_offset_pos:pair_offset_pos+4])[0]\n    size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pair_offset_pos+4:pair_offset_pos+8])[0]\n    \n    if size == 0 or offset &gt;= len(data):\n        return None\n    \n    return data[offset:offset+size]\n\n\ndef get_sprite_hotspot_counts(data: bytes, room_num: int) -&gt; Tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Get sprite and hotspot counts from Pair 10\"\"\"\n    pair10 = read_room_pair(data, room_num, pair_num=10)\n    if pair10 is None:\n        return 0, 0\n    \n    sprite_count = pair10[5] - 2 if len(pair10) &gt; 5 else 0\n    hotspot_count = pair10[0x47A] if len(pair10) &gt; 0x47A else 0\n    \n    return sprite_count, hotspot_count\n\n\ndef decode_byte(b: int) -&gt; Optional[str]:\n    \"\"\"Decode a byte to character\"\"\"\n    if b in SPANISH_CHARS:\n        return SPANISH_CHARS[b]\n    elif 0x20 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7A:\n        return chr(b)\n    else:\n        return None\n\n\ndef clean_text(text: str) -&gt; str:\n    \"\"\"Clean control sequences from text\"\"\"\n    text = text.strip()\n    \n    # Remove leading [XX][00] patterns\n    while text and '[' in text[:15]:\n        idx = text.find('[')\n        if 0 &lt;= idx &lt; 10:\n            end_idx = text.find(']', idx)\n            if idx &lt; end_idx &lt; idx + 10:\n                text = text[end_idx+1:].lstrip()\n            else:\n                break\n        else:\n            break\n    \n    # Remove single leading control characters\n    if len(text) &gt; 1 and text[0] in 'AH' and (text[1].isupper() or text[1] in '¿¡['):\n        text = text[1:].lstrip()\n    elif len(text) &gt; 1 and text[0] in '#%\\')!+,.-\"*&amp;$(/':\n        text = text[1:].lstrip()\n    \n    return text.strip()\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# DESCRIPTION EXTRACTION\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef extract_descriptions(data: bytes, sprite_count: int, hotspot_count: int) -&gt; Tuple[List[str], int]:\n    \"\"\"Extract sprite/hotspot descriptions and return conversation start position\"\"\"\n    descriptions = []\n    desc_count = sprite_count + hotspot_count\n    pos = 0\n    \n    for _ in range(desc_count):\n        # Find FF marker\n        while pos &lt; len(data) and data[pos] != CTRL_DESC_START:\n            pos += 1\n        \n        if pos &gt;= len(data):\n            break\n        \n        pos += 1  # Skip FF\n        if pos + 4 &gt;= len(data):\n            break\n        \n        pos += 4  # Skip item_id and header bytes\n        \n        # Read text until FD\n        text = \"\"\n        while pos &lt; len(data) and data[pos] != CTRL_END_TEXT:\n            char = decode_byte(data[pos])\n            if char:\n                text += char\n            pos += 1\n        \n        if text:\n            descriptions.append(clean_text(text))\n        \n        # Skip FD\n        if pos &lt; len(data) and data[pos] == CTRL_END_TEXT:\n            pos += 1\n    \n    return descriptions, pos\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# CONVERSATION PARSING\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef read_text_until_control(data: bytes, pos: int) -&gt; Tuple[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Read text until hitting a control code\"\"\"\n    end_markers = {\n        CTRL_SPEAKER, CTRL_CHOICE_ONCE, CTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT, CTRL_ACTION,\n        CTRL_END_TEXT, CTRL_TEXT_TERM, CTRL_END_CONV, CTRL_END_BRANCH,\n        CTRL_END_CONV_ALT, CTRL_ROOT_PRIMARY, CTRL_ALT_END, CTRL_GO_BACK\n    }\n    \n    text = \"\"\n    while pos &lt; len(data) and data[pos] not in end_markers:\n        char = decode_byte(data[pos])\n        if char:\n            text += char\n        pos += 1\n    \n    return clean_text(text), pos\n\n\ndef count_choice_indices(data: bytes) -&gt; Counter:\n    \"\"\"Count occurrences of each choice index to detect real choices vs auto-dialogue\"\"\"\n    choice_indices = []\n    pos = 0\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(data):\n        if data[pos] in [CTRL_CHOICE_ONCE, CTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT]:\n            pos += 1\n            if pos &lt; len(data):\n                choice_indices.append(data[pos])\n        pos += 1\n    \n    return Counter(choice_indices)\n\n\ndef parse_conversation_tree(conv_data: bytes, tree: ConversationTree) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Parse conversation data into tree structure\"\"\"\n    if len(conv_data) == 0:\n        return\n    \n    # Count choice indices to detect real choices\n    index_counts = count_choice_indices(conv_data)\n    \n    pos = 0\n    stack = []  # Stack of (node, level) tuples\n    current_root = None\n    current_level = 0\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(conv_data):\n        b = conv_data[pos]\n        \n        # === ROOT PRIMARY (FE) ===\n        if b == CTRL_ROOT_PRIMARY:\n            pos += 1\n            root_index = conv_data[pos] if pos &lt; len(conv_data) else 0\n            pos += 1\n            \n            # Next should be FC (speaker)\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_TEXT_TERM:\n                pos += 1\n                speaker_id = conv_data[pos] if pos &lt; len(conv_data) else 0\n                pos += 1\n                \n                # Skip 08 and voice bytes (3 bytes)\n                if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_SPEAKER:\n                    pos += 4  # Skip 08 + 3 voice bytes\n                \n                # Read text\n                text, pos = read_text_until_control(conv_data, pos)\n                \n                # Create root node\n                current_root = ConversationNode('root')\n                current_root.text = text\n                current_root.speaker = 'NPC'\n                current_root.root_index = root_index\n                tree.roots.append(current_root)\n                stack = [(current_root, 0)]\n                current_level = 0\n        \n        # === ALTERNATIVE ROOT (F7 FC pattern) ===\n        elif b == CTRL_END_BRANCH:\n            pos += 1\n            # Check if followed by FC (alternative root)\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_TEXT_TERM:\n                pos += 1\n                speaker_id = conv_data[pos] if pos &lt; len(conv_data) else 0\n                pos += 1\n                \n                # Skip 08 and voice bytes\n                if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_SPEAKER:\n                    pos += 4\n                \n                text, pos = read_text_until_control(conv_data, pos)\n                \n                current_root = ConversationNode('root')\n                current_root.text = text\n                current_root.speaker = 'NPC'\n                tree.roots.append(current_root)\n                stack = [(current_root, 0)]\n                current_level = 0\n            else:\n                # Just a branch end\n                stack.clear()\n                current_root = None\n        \n        # === NPC SPEAKER (FC) ===\n        elif b == CTRL_TEXT_TERM:\n            pos += 1\n            speaker_id = conv_data[pos] if pos &lt; len(conv_data) else 0\n            pos += 1\n            \n            # Skip 08 and voice bytes\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_SPEAKER:\n                pos += 4\n            \n            text, pos = read_text_until_control(conv_data, pos)\n            \n            node = ConversationNode('npc')\n            node.text = text\n            node.speaker = 'NPC'\n            \n            # Check for action code\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_ACTION:\n                pos += 1\n                if pos + 1 &lt; len(conv_data):\n                    action_lo = conv_data[pos]\n                    action_hi = conv_data[pos + 1]\n                    action_code = action_lo | (action_hi &lt;&lt; 8)\n                    node.action_code = action_code\n                    tree.actions_found.append((action_code, f\"After: {text[:50]}\"))\n                    pos += 2\n            \n            # Check for go back\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_GO_BACK:\n                node.has_go_back = True\n                pos += 1\n            \n            # Attach to parent\n            if stack:\n                parent, _ = stack[-1]\n                parent.children.append(node)\n        \n        # === CHOICE MARKERS (FB, F1) ===\n        elif b in [CTRL_CHOICE_ONCE, CTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT]:\n            choice_type_byte = b\n            pos += 1\n            \n            # Read choice index\n            choice_index = conv_data[pos] if pos &lt; len(conv_data) else 0\n            pos += 1\n            \n            # Check if disabled (FA instead of 08)\n            is_disabled = False\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data):\n                marker = conv_data[pos]\n                if marker == CTRL_DISABLED:\n                    is_disabled = True\n                pos += 1\n            \n            # Skip speaker ID\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data):\n                pos += 1\n            \n            # Read choice text\n            text, pos = read_text_until_control(conv_data, pos)\n            \n            # Skip FD if present\n            if pos &lt; len(conv_data) and conv_data[pos] == CTRL_END_TEXT:\n                pos += 1\n            \n            # Determine if real choice or auto-dialogue\n            is_real_choice = index_counts[choice_index] &gt; 1\n            \n            if is_real_choice:\n                # Real player choice\n                node = ConversationNode('choice')\n                node.text = text\n                node.speaker = 'ALFRED'\n                node.choice_type = 'F1' if choice_type_byte == CTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT else ('FA' if is_disabled else 'FB')\n                node.choice_index = choice_index\n                \n                # Pop stack to correct level\n                while stack and len(stack) &gt; choice_index:\n                    stack.pop()\n                \n                # Attach to parent\n                if stack:\n                    parent, _ = stack[-1]\n                    parent.children.append(node)\n                    stack.append((node, choice_index))\n                elif current_root:\n                    current_root.children.append(node)\n                    stack.append((node, choice_index))\n            else:\n                # Auto-dialogue (Alfred speaks automatically)\n                node = ConversationNode('auto')\n                node.text = text\n                node.speaker = 'ALFRED'\n                node.choice_type = 'F1' if choice_type_byte == CTRL_CHOICE_REPEAT else 'FB'\n                \n                if stack:\n                    parent, _ = stack[-1]\n                    parent.children.append(node)\n        \n        # === ACTION (F8) ===\n        elif b == CTRL_ACTION:\n            pos += 1\n            if pos + 1 &lt; len(conv_data):\n                action_lo = conv_data[pos]\n                action_hi = conv_data[pos + 1]\n                action_code = action_lo | (action_hi &lt;&lt; 8)\n                \n                # Attach to last node in stack\n                if stack:\n                    last_node, _ = stack[-1]\n                    last_node.action_code = action_code\n                    tree.actions_found.append((action_code, f\"After last node: {last_node.text[:50]}\"))\n                \n                pos += 2\n        \n        # === END CONVERSATION (F4) ===\n        elif b == CTRL_END_CONV:\n            if stack:\n                last_node, _ = stack[-1]\n                last_node.has_f4_end = True\n            pos += 1\n        \n        # === GO BACK (F0) ===\n        elif b == CTRL_GO_BACK:\n            if stack:\n                last_node, _ = stack[-1]\n                last_node.has_go_back = True\n            pos += 1\n        \n        # === OTHER CONTROL CODES ===\n        else:\n            pos += 1\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# TREE FORMATTING\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef format_tree_output(tree: ConversationTree) -&gt; List[str]:\n    \"\"\"Format tree with visual hierarchy\"\"\"\n    lines = []\n    \n    lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    lines.append(f\"ROOM {tree.room_num} CONVERSATION TREE\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    if tree.descriptions:\n        lines.append(\"DESCRIPTIONS:\")\n        for i, desc in enumerate(tree.descriptions, 1):\n            lines.append(f\"  #{i}: {desc}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n        lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Print each root\n    for root in tree.roots:\n        format_node(root, lines, prefix=\"\", is_last=True, is_root=True)\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Action summary\n    if tree.actions_found:\n        lines.append(\"\")\n        lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n        lines.append(\"ACTION CODES FOUND IN THIS ROOM\")\n        lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n        lines.append(\"\")\n        \n        # Deduplicate actions\n        unique_actions = {}\n        for action_id, context in tree.actions_found:\n            if action_id not in unique_actions:\n                unique_actions[action_id] = context\n        \n        for action_id in sorted(unique_actions.keys()):\n            context = unique_actions[action_id]\n            lines.append(f\"  → ACTION {action_id:04X} ({action_id:3d})  |  {context}\")\n        \n        lines.append(\"\")\n        lines.append(\"Use these action codes for ScummVM implementation reference.\")\n        lines.append(\"See ACTION_DISPATCH_TABLES.md for handler details.\")\n    \n    # Legend\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    lines.append(\"LEGEND\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    lines.append(\"  [FB-ONCE]      = One-time choice (disabled after selection)\")\n    lines.append(\"  [F1-REPEAT]    = Repeatable choice (can be selected multiple times)\")\n    lines.append(\"  [FA-DISABLED]  = Already disabled choice\")\n    lines.append(\"  [F0-GO_BACK]   = Returns to parent menu after this response\")\n    lines.append(\"  [F4-END]       = Terminates conversation entirely\")\n    lines.append(\"  → ACTION XXXX  = Triggers action code XXXX\")\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    return lines\n\n\ndef format_node(node: ConversationNode, lines: List[str], prefix: str, is_last: bool, is_root: bool = False) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Recursively format a node with tree characters\"\"\"\n    \n    # Determine tree characters\n    if is_root:\n        connector = \"└─ ROOT\"\n        child_prefix = \"   \"\n    else:\n        connector = \"└─\" if is_last else \"├─\"\n        child_prefix = prefix + (\"   \" if is_last else \"│  \")\n    \n    # Format node based on type\n    if node.node_type == 'root':\n        lines.append(f\"{prefix}{connector}\")\n        \n        # Show root index if present\n        root_info = f\" (root #{node.root_index})\" if node.root_index is not None else \"\"\n        lines.append(f\"{child_prefix}NPC: {node.text}{root_info}\")\n        \n    elif node.node_type == 'choice':\n        # Choice marker\n        marker = f\"[{node.choice_type}-{'ONCE' if node.choice_type == 'FB' else ('DISABLED' if node.choice_type == 'FA' else 'REPEAT')}]\"\n        lines.append(f\"{prefix}{connector} [{node.choice_index}] {marker} {node.text}\")\n        \n    elif node.node_type == 'auto':\n        # Auto-dialogue (no menu shown to player)\n        lines.append(f\"{prefix}{connector} [{node.choice_index}] [AUTO-DIALOGUE] {node.text}\")\n        \n    elif node.node_type == 'npc':\n        # NPC response\n        action_str = f\" → ACTION {node.action_code:04X}\" if node.action_code else \"\"\n        go_back_str = \" [F0-GO_BACK]\" if node.has_go_back else \"\"\n        f4_str = \" [F4-END]\" if node.has_f4_end else \"\"\n        \n        lines.append(f\"{prefix}{connector} NPC: {node.text}{action_str}{go_back_str}{f4_str}\")\n    \n    # Format children\n    for i, child in enumerate(node.children):\n        is_last_child = (i == len(node.children) - 1)\n        format_node(child, lines, child_prefix, is_last_child)\n\n\n# ============================================================================\n# MAIN EXTRACTION\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef extract_conversation_tree(alfred1_data: bytes, room_num: int) -&gt; ConversationTree:\n    \"\"\"Extract complete conversation tree for a room\"\"\"\n    tree = ConversationTree(room_num)\n    \n    # Get Pair 12 (text data)\n    pair12 = read_room_pair(alfred1_data, room_num, pair_num=12)\n    if pair12 is None:\n        return tree\n    \n    # Get sprite/hotspot counts to skip descriptions\n    sprite_count, hotspot_count = get_sprite_hotspot_counts(alfred1_data, room_num)\n    \n    # Extract descriptions\n    descriptions, conv_start_pos = extract_descriptions(pair12, sprite_count, hotspot_count)\n    tree.descriptions = descriptions\n    \n    # Get conversation data\n    conv_data = pair12[conv_start_pos:]\n    \n    # Parse conversation tree\n    parse_conversation_tree(conv_data, tree)\n    \n    return tree\n\n\ndef main():\n    if len(sys.argv) &lt; 2:\n        print(\"Usage: python3 src/extract_conversation_tree.py &lt;room_number&gt;\")\n        print(\"\")\n        print(\"Example:\")\n        print(\"  python3 src/extract_conversation_tree.py 22\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    room_num = int(sys.argv[1])\n    \n    print(f\"Loading ALFRED.1...\")\n    alfred1_path = Path('files/ALFRED.1')\n    \n    if not alfred1_path.exists():\n        print(f\"Error: {alfred1_path} not found!\")\n        print(\"Make sure you're running this from the alfredtools directory.\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    with open(alfred1_path, 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    print(f\"Extracting conversation tree for room {room_num}...\")\n    tree = extract_conversation_tree(data, room_num)\n    \n    if not tree.roots and not tree.descriptions:\n        print(f\"Room {room_num} has no conversations.\")\n        return\n    \n    # Format output\n    lines = format_tree_output(tree)\n    \n    # Print to stdout\n    for line in lines:\n        print(line)\n    \n    # Also save to file\n    output_dir = Path('output_conversation_trees')\n    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n    output_file = output_dir / f\"room{room_num:02d}_tree.txt\"\n    \n    with open(output_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \n    print(f\"\\n✓ Tree saved to {output_file}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Read the F8 dispatch table from JUEGO.EXE\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndata = open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb').read()\n\n# Find known string to establish .object2 file base\ntarget = b'HIJODELAGRANPUTA'\npos = data.find(target)\nprint(f'String \"HIJODELAGRANPUTA\" at file offset: 0x{pos:X}')\nprint(f'Ghidra address: 0x40F41')\nobj2_file_base = pos - 0xF41\nprint(f'Object2 file base: 0x{obj2_file_base:X}')\n\n# Dispatch table at Ghidra 0x47E58\ntable_ghidra = 0x47E58\ntable_file = obj2_file_base + (table_ghidra - 0x40000)\nprint(f'Dispatch table file offset: 0x{table_file:X}')\n\n# Also calculate .object1 base using known code patterns\n# .object1 starts at Ghidra 0x10000\nobj1_file_base = None\n# Try to find object1 base from a known function\n# The PUSH 0x34 at start of handle_conversation_tree (0x18690) \n# is bytes 6A 34\ntest_addr = 0x18690\nfor candidate_base in range(0, len(data) - 0x10000, 0x200):\n    test_off = candidate_base + (test_addr - 0x10000)\n    if test_off &lt; len(data) - 2:\n        if data[test_off] == 0x6A and data[test_off+1] == 0x34:\n            obj1_file_base = candidate_base\n            break\n\nif obj1_file_base is not None:\n    print(f'Object1 file base: 0x{obj1_file_base:X}')\n\nprint()\nprint('=== F8 DISPATCH TABLE ===')\nprint(f'{\"Index\":&gt;5} {\"ActionID\":&gt;10} {\"Handler\":&gt;12}')\nprint('-' * 35)\ni = 0\ntarget_action = 0x0164\ntarget_handler = None\nwhile True:\n    off = table_file + i * 6\n    action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, off)[0]\n    handler_raw = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, off + 2)[0]\n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f'  END OF TABLE at index {i}')\n        break\n    # Handler pointer needs +0x10000 fixup per the guide\n    handler = handler_raw + 0x10000\n    marker = \" &lt;-- TARGET\" if action_id == target_action else \"\"\n    print(f'{i:5d} 0x{action_id:04X} ({action_id:&gt;5d})  0x{handler:05X}{marker}')\n    if action_id == target_action:\n        target_handler = handler\n    if i &gt; 200:\n        print('  SAFETY LIMIT')\n        break\n    i += 1\n\nif target_handler:\n    print(f'\\n=== ACTION 0x0164 HANDLER ===')\n    print(f'Handler Ghidra address: 0x{target_handler:05X}')\n    if obj1_file_base is not None:\n        handler_file = obj1_file_base + (target_handler - 0x10000)\n        print(f'Handler file offset: 0x{handler_file:X}')\n        # Print first 64 bytes of handler\n        print(f'First 64 bytes at handler:')\n        for row in range(4):\n            addr = handler_file + row * 16\n            hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{data[addr+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n            print(f'  0x{target_handler + row*16:05X}: {hex_bytes}')\n",

0xF41  # = 0x43200\n\n# Find Object1 base by searching for a known code pattern\n# handle_conversation_tree at 0x18690 starts with PUSH 0x34 (6A 34)\n# followed by CALL rel32 (E8 xx xx xx xx)\n# The CALL target is 0x2A218, so rel32 = 0x2A218 - 0x18695 = 0x11B83\ncall_target_bytes = struct.pack('&lt;i', 0x2A218 - 0x18695)\npattern = bytes([0x6A, 0x34, 0xE8]) + call_target_bytes\npositions = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(pattern), data)]\nprint(f\"Looking for handle_conversation_tree prologue pattern...\")\nfor p in positions:\n    implied_obj1_base = p - (0x18690 - 0x10000)\n    print(f\"  Found at file 0x{p:X}, implied obj1 base = 0x{implied_obj1_base:X}\")\n\n# If not found with exact pattern, try with just PUSH 0x34 and verify\nif not positions:\n    print(\"  Exact pattern not found, trying broader search...\")\n    pattern2 = bytes([0x6A, 0x34, 0xE8])\n    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(pattern2), data):\n        p = m.start()\n        implied_base = p - (0x18690 - 0x10000)\n        # Verify by checking another known byte nearby\n        if 0 &lt;= implied_base &lt; len(data):\n            # Check if bytes at 0x1869A-0x1869E are PUSH EBX, PUSH ECX, PUSH EDX, PUSH ESI, PUSH EDI\n            # Which is 53 51 52 56 57\n            test_off = implied_base + (0x1869A - 0x10000)\n            if test_off + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                if data[test_off:test_off+5] == bytes([0x53, 0x51, 0x52, 0x56, 0x57]):\n                    print(f\"  Verified at file 0x{p:X}, obj1 base = 0x{implied_base:X}\")\n                    positions = [p]\n                    break\n\nif positions:\n    obj1_file_base = positions[0] - (0x18690 - 0x10000)\nelse:\n    # Fallback: try computing from obj2 base\n    # obj2 at 0x43200 for ghidra 0x40000\n    # obj1 should be earlier in the file\n    # In LE format, the code object usually starts right after the header\n    # Let's try: obj1_base = obj2_base -   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Verify obj1 base and disassemble handler for action 0x0164\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport re\n\ndata = open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb').read()\n\n# Verify obj1 base by finding a known instruction\n# At Ghidra 0x187EB: MOV BX,word ptr [EAX + 0x47e58]\n# In 32-bit mode: 66 8B 98 58 7E 04 00\npattern = bytes([0x66, 0x8B, 0x98, 0x58, 0x7E, 0x04, 0x00])\npos = data.find(pattern)\nif pos &gt;= 0:\n    obj1_base = pos - (0x187EB - 0x10000)\n    print(f\"Found MOV BX,[EAX+0x47E58] at file 0x{pos:X}\")\n    print(f\"Verified obj1 file base: 0x{obj1_base:X}\")\nelse:\n    # Try without the 66 prefix\n    pattern2 = bytes([0x8B, 0x98, 0x58, 0x7E, 0x04, 0x00])\n    pos = data.find(pattern2)\n    if pos &gt;= 0:\n        obj1_base = (pos - 1) - (0x187EB - 0x10000)\n        print(f\"Found at file 0x{pos:X} (no 66 prefix)\")\n        print(f\"obj1 base: 0x{obj1_base:X}\")\n    else:\n        # Search for CALL dword ptr [EAX + 0x47E5A] = FF 90 5A 7E 04 00\n        pattern3 = bytes([0xFF, 0x90, 0x5A, 0x7E, 0x04, 0x00])\n        pos = data.find(pattern3)\n        if pos &gt;= 0:\n            # This is at Ghidra 0x187FF\n            obj1_base = pos - (0x187FF - 0x10000)\n            print(f\"Found CALL [EAX+0x47E5A] at file 0x{pos:X}\")\n            print(f\"obj1 base: 0x{obj1_base:X}\")\n        else:\n            print(\"Could not find calibration pattern!\")\n            # Try yet another: CMP EBX,0xFFFF at 0x187F2 = 81 FB FF FF 00 00\n            pattern4 = bytes([0x81, 0xFB, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00])\n            for m in re.finditer(re.escape(pattern4), data):\n                p = m.start()\n                # Check if preceded by MOV BX pattern\n                print(f\"  CMP EBX,0xFFFF at file 0x{p:X}\")\n            obj1_base = 0x13200  # fallback\n\nprint(f\"\\nUsing obj1_base = 0x{obj1_base:X}\")\n\n# Handler at Ghidra 0x2218F\nhandler_ghidra = 0x2218F\nhandler_file = obj1_base + (handler_ghidra - 0x10000)\nprint(f\"Handler file offset: 0x{handler_file:X}\")\n\n# Dump 128 bytes starting from handler\nprint(f\"\\n=== RAW BYTES at 0x{handler_ghidra:05X} (128 bytes) ===\")\nfor row in range(8):\n    addr = handler_file + row * 16\n    ghidra_addr = handler_ghidra + row * 16\n    if addr + 16 &lt;= len(data):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{data[addr+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n        ascii_str = ''.join(chr(data[addr+j]) if 32 &lt;= data[addr+j] &lt; 127 else '.' for j in range(16))\n        print(f'  0x{ghidra_addr:05X}: {hex_bytes}  {ascii_str}')\n\n# Dump common handler at 0x2151D\nprint(f\"\\n=== COMMON HANDLER at 0x2151D (first 32 bytes) ===\")\ncommon_file = obj1_base + (0x2151D - 0x10000)\nfor row in range(2):\n    addr = common_file + row * 16\n    ghidra_addr = 0x2151D + row * 16\n    if addr + 16 &lt;= len(data):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{data[addr+j]:02X}' for j in range(16))\n        print(f'  0x{ghidra_addr:05X}: {hex_bytes}')\n\n# Also look at a few known handlers around 0x2218F\n# 0x2215E (action 0x0161) \n# 0x2217B (action 0x0162)\n# 0x2218F (action 0x0164) &lt;-- TARGET\n# 0x221A2 (action 0x0165)\n# 0x221C5 (action 0x0166)\nprint(f\"\\n=== CONTEXT: Actions 0x0161 through 0x0166 handlers ===\")\nfor action_id, handler_addr in [(0x0161, 0x2215E), (0x0162, 0x2217B), \n                                  (0x0164, 0x2218F), (0x0165, 0x221A2),\n                                  (0x0166, 0x221C5)]:\n    hfile = obj1_base + (handler_addr - 0x10000)\n    # Get 32 bytes\n    hbytes = data[hfile:hfile+32]\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in hbytes)\n    print(f\"  Action 0x{action_id:04X} @ 0x{handler_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "import struct\n\n# Handler at Ghidra 0x2218F for action 0x0164\n# Raw bytes from JUEGO.EXE (with relocations needing fixup)\n\nhandler_bytes = bytes([\n    0xC6, 0x40, 0x01, 0xB4,\n    0xA1, 0x4C, 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xC6, 0x40, 0x04, 0xB4,\n    0xA1, 0x4C, 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xBB, 0x02, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xBA, 0xAE, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xE8, 0x1F, 0x98, 0xFF, 0xFF,\n    0xA1, 0x48, 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xBB, 0xD7, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xBA, 0xA1, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,\n    0xE8, 0x0B, 0x98, 0xFF, 0xFF,\n    0xE8, 0x94, 0x50, 0xFF, 0xFF,\n    0xE8, 0x8A, 0x40, 0xFF, 0xFF,\n])\n\nbase = 0x2218F\n\nprint(\"=== HANDLER 0x0164 (356 decimal) at Ghidra 0x2218F ===\")\nprint()\n\n# But wait - the first instruction is C6 40 01 B4, and EAX must have been loaded\n# BEFORE this handler. Let's check what comes right before 0x2218F.\n# The handler at 0x2217B (action 0x0162) ends at 0x2218F.\n# Raw bytes for 0x0162 handler: 00 00 83 C0 10 BB 0A 00 00 00 E8 E1 94 00 00 A1 4C C0 00 00\n# The last 5 bytes: A1 4C C0 00 00 = MOV EAX, [0x0004C04C]\n# So the FALL-THROUGH from 0x0162 loads EAX = [0x0004C04C]!\n\nprint(\"CONTEXT: Handler 0x0162 (at 0x2217B) ends with:\")\nprint(\"  MOV EAX, [0x0004C04C]  ; loads game state pointer\")\nprint(\"  (falls through into 0x0164 handler)\")\nprint()\n\n# Decode handler 0x0164 starting at 0x2218F\nprint(\"DISASSEMBLY:\")\npos = 0\ncall_targets = []\ninstructions = []\n\nwhile pos &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n    addr = base + pos\n    if handler_bytes[pos] == 0xC6 and handler_bytes[pos+1] == 0x40:\n        disp = handler_bytes[pos+2]\n        imm = handler_bytes[pos+3]\n        inst = f\"MOV byte ptr [EAX+0x{disp:02X}], 0x{imm:02X} ({imm})\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        pos += 4\n    elif handler_bytes[pos] == 0xA1:\n        raw_addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n        relocated = raw_addr + 0x40000\n        inst = f\"MOV EAX, [0x{relocated:08X}]  ; raw=0x{raw_addr:08X}\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        pos += 5\n    elif handler_bytes[pos] == 0xBB:\n        val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n        inst = f\"MOV EBX, 0x{val:08X} ({val})\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        pos += 5\n    elif handler_bytes[pos] == 0xBA:\n        val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n        inst = f\"MOV EDX, 0x{val:08X} ({val})\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        pos += 5\n    elif handler_bytes[pos] == 0xE8:\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n        next_ip = base + pos + 5\n        target = next_ip + offset\n        inst = f\"CALL 0x{target:05X}  ; rel offset = {offset}\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        call_targets.append((addr, target))\n        pos += 5\n    else:\n        inst = f\"??? 0x{handler_bytes[pos]:02X}\"\n        instructions.append((addr, inst))\n        pos += 1\n\nfor addr, inst in instructions:\n    print(f\"  0x{addr:05X}: {inst}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== CALL TARGET ANALYSIS ===\")\nfor call_addr, target in call_targets:\n    print(f\"  CALL at 0x{call_addr:05X} -&gt; 0x{target:05X}\")\n\n# Known functions\nknown = {\n    0x1B666: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x15E4C: \"render_scene\",\n    0x1625D: \"present_frame_to_screen\",\n    0x2A258: \"wait_or_process_input\",\n    0x29037: \"init_or_stop_sound\",\n    0x152B6: \"check_keyboard_input\",\n    0x2B12F: \"random_number_generator\",\n    0x2B11B: \"outport_byte\",\n    0x15DD4: \"copy_background_to_front_buffer\",\n    0x1B9BE: \"update_conversation_state_alt\",\n}\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== FUNCTION IDENTIFICATION ===\")\nfor call_addr, target in call_targets:\n    name = known.get(target, \"UNKNOWN\")\n    print(f\"  0x{target:05X} = {name}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== WATCOM CALLING CONVENTION ===\")\nprint(\"Parameters: EAX, EDX, EBX, ECX (in order)\")\nprint()\n\n# Reconstruct pseudocode\nprint(\"=== PSEUDOCODE ===\")\nprint(\"\"\"\n// EAX = loaded from [0x0004C04C] by falling through from action 0x0162 handler\n// 0x0004C04C is likely a pointer to room sprite data or conversation state\n\n// Modify the struct pointed to by EAX\nbyte_at(EAX + 0x01) = 0xB4;   // Set byte at offset 1 to 180\n\nEAX = *(uint32*)(0x0004C04C);  // Reload pointer\nbyte_at(EAX + 0x04) = 0xB4;   // Set byte at offset 4 to 180\n\nEAX = *(uint32*)(0x0004C04C);  // Reload pointer\n\"\"\")\n\n# Call 1: EAX=ptr, EBX=0x102 (258), EDX=0xAE (174)\n# Call 2: EAX=[0x0004C048], EBX=0xD7 (215), EDX=0xA1 (161)\n\nfor call_addr, target in call_targets:\n    name = known.get(target, f\"FUN_{target:05X}\")\n    if target == call_targets[0][1]:\n        print(f\"// First call with: EAX=[0x0004C04C], EBX=258 (0x102), EDX=174 (0xAE)\")\n    elif target == call_targets[1][1] and call_addr == call_targets[1][0]:\n        print(f\"// Second call with: EAX=[0x0004C048], EBX=215 (0xD7), EDX=161 (0xA1)\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== MEMORY ADDRESS ANALYSIS ===\")\nprint(\"0x0004C04C - Pointer loaded via MOV EAX, [0x0004C04C] (3 times)\")\nprint(\"0x0004C048 - Pointer loaded via MOV EAX, [0x0004C048] (1 time)\")\nprint(\"These are likely NPC/hotspot state pointers for room 23\")\n",

}

6:\n            break\n        action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0)[0]\n        stored_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 2)[0]\n        \n        if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(\"END OF TABLE at entry %d\" % i)\n            break\n        \n        ghidra_addr = stored_ptr + 0x10000\n        \n        if 0x0160 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 0x016A:\n            print(\"Entry %d: action 0x%04X (%d) stored=0x%08X ghidra=0x%05X\" % (\n                i, action_id, action_id, stored_ptr, ghidra_addr))\n\n    # Now read bytes at the Ghidra address for action 0x0164 = 0x2218F\n    # File offset from Ghidra: ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    ghidra = 0x2218F\n    file_off = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    print()\n    print(\"Handler 0x0164 at Ghidra 0x%05X, file offset 0x%05X\" % (ghidra, file_off))\n    f.seek(file_off)\n    raw = f.read(80)\n    print(\"Raw bytes: \" + raw.hex())\n    \n    # But what if the file offset formula is different?\n    # obj1_base = 0x13200 means the code segment starts at file offset 0x13200\n    # and loads at Ghidra 0x10000\n    # So: file_offset = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n    file_off2 = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n    print()\n    print(\"Alt formula (obj1_base=0x13200): file offset 0x%05X\" % file_off2)\n    f.seek(file_off2)\n    raw2 = f.read(80)\n    print(\"Raw bytes: \" + raw2.hex())\n    \n    # Try another formula\n    # Maybe the code section starts at different offset\n    # Let's check the PE/MZ header to find code section offset\n    f.seek(0)\n    mz = f.read(2)\n    print()\n    print(\"File starts with: \" + mz.hex())\n    \n    # Read MZ header to find LE/PE offset\n    f.seek(0x3C)\n    pe_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', f.read(4), 0)[0]\n    print(\"PE/LE offset at 0x3C: 0x%X\" % pe_offset)\n",

  "textEditContent": "import struct\n\n# Read the raw bytes around 0x1B9CF from JUEGO.EXE\n# Formula: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n\nghidra = 0x1B9CF\nfile_off = ghidra - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n\nprint(\"Looking at Ghidra 0x%05X, file offset 0x%05X\" % (ghidra, file_off))\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read 64 bytes before and 128 bytes at the address\n    f.seek(file_off - 32)\n    pre = f.read(32)\n    print(\"Pre-bytes (-32): \" + pre.hex())\n    \n    f.seek(file_off)\n    data = f.read(128)\n    print(\"Bytes at 0x1B9CF: \" + data[:32].hex())\n    print(\"                  \" + data[32:64].hex())\n    print(\"                  \" + data[64:96].hex())\n    print(\"                  \" + data[96:128].hex())\n\n    # Also check what the calls from the handler 0x0164 point to\n    # The calls use Watcom calling convention: EAX, EDX, EBX, ECX\n    # First call: EAX=[0x4C04C], EBX=258, EDX=174\n    # Second call: EAX=[0x4C048], EBX=215, EDX=161\n    \n    # Let's also look at the other call targets\n    for target_name, target_addr in [(\"0x1B9CF\", 0x1B9CF), (\"0x1725D\", 0x1725D), (\"0x16258\", 0x16258)]:\n        foff = target_addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n        f.seek(foff)\n        raw = f.read(32)\n        print()\n        print(\"Target %s (file 0x%05X):\" % (target_name, foff))\n        print(\"  Bytes: \" + raw.hex())\n        # Decode first few instructions\n        pos = 0\n        while pos &lt; len(raw) and pos &lt; 20:\n            b = raw[pos]\n            if b == 0xC3:\n                print(\"  [%d] RET\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x55:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH EBP\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x53:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH EBX\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x52:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH EDX\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x51:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH ECX\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x50:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH EAX\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x56:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH ESI\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x57:\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH EDI\" % pos)\n                pos += 1\n            elif b == 0x68 and pos + 4 &lt; len(raw):\n                val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, pos+1)[0]\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH 0x%08X\" % (pos, val))\n                pos += 5\n            elif b == 0x6A and pos + 1 &lt; len(raw):\n                val = raw[pos+1]\n                print(\"  [%d] PUSH 0x%02X\" % (pos, val))\n                pos += 2\n            elif b == 0xE8 and pos + 4 &lt; len(raw):\n                offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', raw, pos+1)[0]\n                tgt = target_addr + pos + 5 + offset\n                print(\"  [%d] CALL 0x%05X\" % (pos, tgt))\n                pos += 5\n            elif b == 0xA1 and pos + 4 &lt; len(raw):\n                addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, pos+1)[0]\n                relocated = addr + 0x40000\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV EAX, [0x%08X]\" % (pos, relocated))\n                pos += 5\n            elif b == 0x89:\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV r/m32, reg (modrm=0x%02X)\" % (pos, raw[pos+1]))\n                pos += 2\n            elif b == 0x8B:\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV reg, r/m32 (modrm=0x%02X)\" % (pos, raw[pos+1]))\n                pos += 2\n            elif b == 0x83 and pos + 2 &lt; len(raw):\n                print(\"  [%d] OP r/m32, imm8 (modrm=0x%02X, imm=0x%02X)\" % (pos, raw[pos+1], raw[pos+2]))\n                pos += 3\n            elif b == 0x88:\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV r/m8, reg (modrm=0x%02X)\" % (pos, raw[pos+1]))\n                pos += 2\n            elif b == 0xC6 and pos + 3 &lt; len(raw):\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV byte [EAX+0x%02X], 0x%02X\" % (pos, raw[pos+2], raw[pos+3]))\n                pos += 4\n            elif b == 0xBB and pos + 4 &lt; len(raw):\n                val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, pos+1)[0]\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV EBX, %d\" % (pos, val))\n                pos += 5\n            elif b == 0xBA and pos + 4 &lt; len(raw):\n                val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, pos+1)[0]\n                print(\"  [%d] MOV EDX, %d\" % (pos, val))\n                pos += 5\n            else:\n                print(\"  [%d] 0x%02X\" % (pos, b))\n                pos += 1\n",

  "textEditContent": "import struct\n\n# Read from the ACTUAL file bytes at the handler location\n# and decode the CALL targets from there\n\nwith open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n    # Handler at Ghidra 0x2218F, file offset = 0x2218F - 0x10000 + 0x13200 = 0x2538F\n    handler_file_offset = 0x2538F\n    f.seek(handler_file_offset)\n    raw = f.read(128)\n    \n    print(\"Raw handler bytes from EXE (first 64):\")\n    for i in range(0, 64, 16):\n        hex_str = \" \".join(\"%02X\" % b for b in raw[i:i+16])\n        print(\"  0x%05X: %s\" % (0x2218F + i, hex_str))\n    print()\n    \n    # Find all E8 CALL instructions\n    base = 0x2218F  # Ghidra base address of the handler\n    \n    print(\"=== E8 CALL instructions ===\")\n    for i in range(len(raw) - 5):\n        if raw[i] == 0xE8:\n            offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', raw, i+1)[0]\n            next_ip = base + i + 5  # IP after the CALL instruction\n            target = next_ip + offset\n            \n            # Only show calls in a reasonable range\n            if 0x10000 &lt; target &lt; 0x50000 and i &lt; 64:\n                print(\"  Offset +%02d (0x%05X): E8 %s -&gt; target 0x%05X\" % (\n                    i, base+i, raw[i+1:i+5].hex(), target))\n    \n    print()\n    \n    # Also check for A1 (MOV EAX, [imm32]) instructions with relocation\n    print(\"=== A1 MOV EAX, [addr] instructions (raw, needs +0x40000) ===\")\n    for i in range(len(raw) - 5):\n        if raw[i] == 0xA1 and i &lt; 64:\n            addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', raw, i+1)[0]\n            # Check if this looks like a data address\n            if addr &lt; 0x10000:  # raw unrelocated addr\n                print(\"  Offset +%02d (0x%05X): A1 %s -&gt; [0x%08X] (relocated: [0x%08X])\" % (\n                    i, base+i, raw[i+1:i+5].hex(), addr, addr + 0x40000))\n\n    # Now also check what's at the nearby handler 0x221A2 (action 0x0165)\n    # to see where handler 0x0164 ends\n    print()\n    print(\"=== Handler 0x0165 at 0x221A2 (offset +19 from handler 0x0164 start) ===\")\n    handler_0165_offset = 0x221A2 - 0x2218F  # = 19 bytes\n    print(\"Handler 0x0164 is only %d bytes!\" % handler_0165_offset)\n    print(\"First bytes of handler 0x0165: \" + \" \".join(\"%02X\" % b for b in raw[handler_0165_offset:handler_0165_offset+32]))\n    \n    # The handler 0x0164 is at 0x2218F and ends before 0x221A2\n    # That's only 19 bytes:\n    handler_bytes = raw[:handler_0165_offset]\n    print()\n    print(\"=== Complete handler 0x0164 (%d bytes) ===\" % len(handler_bytes))\n    print(\" \".join(\"%02X\" % b for b in handler_bytes))\n    \n    # Now decode those 19 bytes\n    print()\n    print(\"=== DECODED HANDLER 0x0164 ===\")\n    pos = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n        addr = base + pos\n        b = handler_bytes[pos]\n        \n        if b == 0xC6 and pos+3 &lt; len(handler_bytes) and handler_bytes[pos+1] == 0x40:\n            disp = handler_bytes[pos+2]\n            imm = handler_bytes[pos+3]\n            print(\"  0x%05X: C6 40 %02X %02X   MOV byte ptr [EAX+0x%02X], 0x%02X (%d)\" % (\n                addr, disp, imm, disp, imm, imm))\n            pos += 4\n        elif b == 0xA1 and pos+4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            raw_addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n            relocated = raw_addr + 0x40000\n            print(\"  0x%05X: A1 %s     MOV EAX, [0x%08X]\" % (\n                addr, handler_bytes[pos+1:pos+5].hex(), relocated))\n            pos += 5\n        elif b == 0xBB and pos+4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n            print(\"  0x%05X: BB %s     MOV EBX, %d (0x%X)\" % (\n                addr, handler_bytes[pos+1:pos+5].hex(), val, val))\n            pos += 5\n        elif b == 0xBA and pos+4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n            print(\"  0x%05X: BA %s     MOV EDX, %d (0x%X)\" % (\n                addr, handler_bytes[pos+1:pos+5].hex(), val, val))\n            pos += 5\n        elif b == 0xE8 and pos+4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n            next_ip = addr + 5\n            target = next_ip + offset\n            print(\"  0x%05X: E8 %s     CALL 0x%05X\" % (\n                addr, handler_bytes[pos+1:pos+5].hex(), target))\n            pos += 5\n        elif b == 0xC3:\n            print(\"  0x%05X: C3            RET\" % addr)\n            pos += 1\n        elif b == 0xE9 and pos+4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', handler_bytes, pos+1)[0]\n            target = addr + 5 + offset\n            print(\"  0x%05X: E9 %s     JMP 0x%05X\" % (\n                addr, handler_bytes[pos+1:pos+5].hex(), target))\n            pos += 5\n        elif b == 0xEB and pos+1 &lt;   "textEditContent": "import struct\n\n# File offset formula: file_offset = ghidra_addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\ndef ghidra_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n\nexe_path = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\nwith open(exe_path, \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read handler 0x0161 (Ghidra 0x2215E) and 0x0162 (Ghidra 0x2217B)\n    # to understand how EAX and [0x4C04C] are set up before 0x0164 entry\n    start_ghidra = 0x2215E  # handler 0x0161 entry\n    end_ghidra = 0x2218F    # handler 0x0164 entry (exclusive)\n    \n    file_off = ghidra_to_file(start_ghidra)\n    size = end_ghidra - start_ghidra\n    f.seek(file_off)\n    data = f.read(size)\n    \n    print(\"=== HANDLERS 0x0161 and 0x0162 (preceding 0x0164) ===\")\n    print(f\"Ghidra: 0x{start_ghidra:X} - 0x{end_ghidra:X} ({size} bytes)\")\n    print(f\"File offset: 0x{file_off:X}\")\n    print(\"Raw bytes:\", data.hex())\n    print()\n    \n    # Also read the function at 0x1B9CF - the key unknown function\n    # Read 256 bytes to capture enough of it\n    func_ghidra = 0x1B9CF\n    func_file = ghidra_to_file(func_ghidra)\n    f.seek(func_file)\n    func_data = f.read(256)\n    \n    print(\"=== FUNCTION at 0x1B9CF (called twice by handler 0x0164) ===\")\n    print(f\"Ghidra: 0x{func_ghidra:X}\")\n    print(f\"File offset: 0x{func_file:X}\")\n    print(\"First 256 bytes:\", func_data.hex())\n    print()\n    \n    # Also read the BROADER context: handler 0x0160 (at 0x2151D) which is labeled \"shared/RET\"\n    # This likely just returns immediately\n    h0160_ghidra = 0x2151D\n    h0160_file = ghidra_to_file(h0160_ghidra)\n    f.seek(h0160_file)\n    h0160_data = f.read(16)\n    print(f\"=== HANDLER 0x0160 at 0x{h0160_ghidra:X} (shared/RET) ===\")\n    print(\"Bytes:\", h0160_data.hex())\n    print()\n\n    # Read the area around 0x4C04C and 0x4C048 in the data segment\n    # These are DATA addresses in the game's memory. In the EXE file,\n    # data segment is different from code. Let me check if these are\n    # in the relocation fixup tables or if they're static data.\n    # Data addresses 0x4C04C and 0x4C048 - these look like they could be\n    # global pointers. Let me search for references to them in the code.\n    \n    # Search for the bytes 4C C0 04 00 (little-endian 0x0004C04C) in code\n    f.seek(0)\n    exe_data = f.read()\n    \n    # The raw (pre-relocation) form would be 0x0000C04C\n    # In the EXE, the instruction \"MOV EAX, [0x0004C04C]\" is encoded as:\n    # A1 4C C0 00 00 (raw, before relocation adds 0x40000)\n    search_raw = bytes([0x4C, 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00])\n    search_raw2 = bytes([0x48, 0xC0, 0x00, 0x00])\n    \n    print(\"=== SEARCHING for raw references to 0xC04C (=0x4C04C pre-reloc) ===\")\n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        idx = exe_data.find(search_raw, pos)\n        if idx == -1:\n            break\n        # Convert to Ghidra addr\n        g_addr = idx - 0x13200 + 0x10000\n        context = exe_data[max(0,idx-2):idx+8]\n        print(f\"  Found at file 0x{idx:X} (Ghidra ~0x{g_addr:X}): ...{context.hex()}...\")\n        pos = idx + 1\n        count += 1\n    print(f\"  Total: {count} occurrences\")\n    print()\n    \n    print(\"=== SEARCHING for raw references to 0xC048 (=0x4C048 pre-reloc) ===\")\n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        idx = exe_data.find(search_raw2, pos)\n        if idx == -1:\n            break\n        g_addr = idx - 0x13200 + 0x10000\n        context = exe_data[max(0,idx-2):idx+8]\n        print(f\"  Found at file 0x{idx:X} (Ghidra ~0x{g_addr:X}): ...{context.hex()}...\")\n        pos = idx + 1\n        count += 1\n    print(f\"  Total: {count} occurrences\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Also search for 0x95BC and 0x95BD (raw form of 0x495BC/0x495BD)\n    search_95bc = bytes([0xBC, 0x95, 0x00, 0x00])\n    search_95bd = bytes([0xBD, 0x95, 0x00, 0x00])\n    \n    print(\"=== SEARCHING for raw references to 0x95BC (=0x495BC pre-reloc) ===\")\n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        idx = exe_data.find(search_95bc, pos)\n        if idx == -1:\n            break\n        g_addr = idx -   "textEditContent": "import struct\n\n# Capstone disassembler\ntry:\n    from capstone import *\n    HAS_CAPSTONE = True\nexcept ImportError:\n    HAS_CAPSTONE = False\n\nexe_path = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n\nwith open(exe_path, \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(0)\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Decode handlers 0x0161 and 0x0162\n# 0x0161 at Ghidra 0x2215E, 0x0162 at 0x2217B, 0x0164 at 0x2218F\n# But we also need context BEFORE 0x0161 to understand what sets up state\n\n# Look at the FULL chain of nearby handlers from ACTION_DISPATCH_TABLES:\n# 0x0160 → 0x2151D (shared/RET - just a C3 RET)\n# 0x0161 → 0x2215E  \n# 0x0162 → 0x2217B\n# 0x0163 → 0x2151D (shared/RET)\n# 0x0164 → 0x2218F\n# 0x0165 → 0x221A2\n# 0x0166 → 0x221C5\n\n# Let me also look for what's BEFORE 0x2215E to see if there's a shared preamble\n# The action 0x0161 entry is at 0x2215E. Let me read from a bit before that.\n\n# Check what's at 0x22147 (one of the 0xC048 refs, before 0x2215E)\n# 0x22147 is 23 bytes before 0x2215E\n# Let me read from 0x22130 to get full context\n\nstart = 0x22130\nend = 0x2221C\nsize = end - start\nfile_off = ghidra_to_file(start)\ncode_bytes = exe_data[file_off:file_off + size]\n\nif HAS_CAPSTONE:\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = False\n    \n    # Known entry points for markers\n    entries = {\n        0x22147: \"-- [0xC048 ref #1] --\",\n        0x2215E: \"=== HANDLER 0x0161 ENTRY ===\",\n        0x22179: \"-- [0xC048 ref #2] --\",\n        0x2217B: \"=== HANDLER 0x0162 ENTRY ===\",\n        0x2218F: \"=== HANDLER 0x0164 ENTRY ===\",\n        0x221A2: \"=== HANDLER 0x0165 ENTRY ===\",\n        0x221C5: \"=== HANDLER 0x0166 ENTRY (loop) ===\",\n    }\n    \n    # Data address annotations\n    data_addrs = {\n        0x0000C04C: \"ptr_to_NPC_struct_A (0x4C04C)\",\n        0x0000C048: \"ptr_to_NPC_struct_B (0x4C048)\",\n        0x000095BC: \"game_flag_0x495BC\",\n        0x000095BD: \"game_flag_0x495BD\",\n        0x0000FAC8: \"room_sprite_data_ptr\",\n        0x0000FB94: \"current_room_number\",\n    }\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    print(\"FULL HANDLER CHAIN DECODE: 0x22130 - 0x2221C\")\n    print(\"(Handlers 0x0161 through 0x0166 with fall-through)\")\n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    \n    for insn in md.disasm(code_bytes, start):\n        # Check entry point markers\n        if insn.address in entries:\n            print(f\"\\n  {entries[insn.address]}\")\n        \n        # Annotate data addresses\n        annotation = \"\"\n        for raw_addr, name in data_addrs.items():\n            hex_str = f\"0x{raw_addr:x}\"\n            if hex_str in insn.op_str:\n                annotation = f\"  ; {name}\"\n                break\n        \n        # Annotate known functions  \n        if insn.mnemonic == \"call\":\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target == 0x1B9CF:\n                    annotation = \"  ; UNKNOWN_FUNC(EAX=ptr, EDX=val1, EBX=val2)\"\n                elif target == 0x1725D:\n                    annotation = \"  ; render_alfred_sprite_scaled+0x265\"\n                elif target == 0x16258:\n                    annotation = \"  ; process_room_logic+0x11\"\n                elif target == 0x22008:\n                    annotation = \"  ; nearby_func\"\n                elif target == 0x2B566:\n                    annotation = \"  ; set_hotspot_action_code\"\n                elif target == 0x1B666:\n                    annotation = \"  ; update_conversation_state\"\n            except:\n                pass\n        \n        print(f\"  0x{insn.address:05X}: {insn.mnemonic:8s} {insn.op_str}{annotation}\")\n\n    print()\n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    print(\"FUNCTION 0x1B9CF DECODE (first 256 bytes)\")\n    print(\"Called with: EAX=pointer, EDX=value1, EBX=value2\")\n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    \n    func_off = ghidra_to_file(0x1B9CF)\n    func_bytes = exe_data[func_off:func_off + 256]\n    \n    for insn in md.disasm(func_bytes, 0x1B9CF):\n        annotation = \"\"\n        for raw_addr, name in data_addrs.items():\n            hex_str = f\"0x{raw_addr:x}\"\n            if hex_str in insn.op_str:\n                annotation = f\"  ; {name}\"\n                break\n                \n        # Check for known function calls\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"call\":\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target == 0x1B9CF:\n                    annotation = \"  ; RECURSIVE\"\n                elif target == 0x2B218 or target == 0x2A218:\n                    annotation = \"  ; __STK (stack check)\"\n            except:\n                pass\n        \n        print(f\"  0x{insn.address:05X}: {insn.mnemonic:8s} {insn.op_str}{annotation}\")\n\n    # Also decode the other references to 0x495BC\n    print()\n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    print(\"OTHER REFERENCES TO 0x495BC (not in handler 0x0164)\")\n    print(\"=\" * 80)\n    \n    # References found at Ghidra: 0x1FD49, 0x1FD63, 0x1FE08, 0x1FE1C\n    # These are all close together - around 0x1FD27 to 0x1FE1C\n    # Let me decode the region\n    region_start = 0x1FD20\n    region_end = 0x1FE40\n    r_off = ghidra_to_file(region_start)\n    r_bytes = exe_data[r_off:r_off + (region_end - region_start)]\n    \n    for insn in md.disasm(r_bytes, region_start):\n        annotation = \"\"\n        if \"0x95bc\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; &lt;&lt;&lt; 0x495BC\"\n        elif \"0x95bd\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; &lt;&lt;&lt; 0x495BD\"\n        elif \"0x95ba\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; 0x495BA\"\n        elif \"0x95be\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; 0x495BE\"\n        elif \"0xfac8\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; room_sprite_data_ptr\"\n        elif \"0xfb94\" in insn.op_str:\n            annotation = \"  ; current_room_number\"\n        \n        print(f\"  0x{insn.address:05X}: {insn.mnemonic:8s} {insn.op_str}{annotation}\")\n\nelse:\n    print(\"capstone not installed, showing raw hex only\")\n    # Show raw hex\n    start = 0x2215E\n    end = 0x2218F\n    file_off = ghidra_to_file(start)\n    data = exe_data[file_off:file_off + (end - start)]\n    print(f\"Handlers 0x0161-0x0162: {data.hex()}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "import struct\n\nexe_path = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x13200\n\nwith open(exe_path, \"rb\") as f:\n    # Read raw bytes around handler 0x0161 entry (Ghidra 0x2215E)\n    # Check a few bytes before to see if C6 precedes\n    start = 0x22158\n    count = 60\n    f.seek(ghidra_to_file(start))\n    data = f.read(count)\n    \n    print(f\"Raw bytes from 0x{start:05X}:\")\n    for i in range(count):\n        addr = start + i\n        b = data[i]\n        marker = \"\"\n        if addr == 0x2215E:\n            marker = \" &lt;&lt;&lt; 0x0161 entry\"\n        elif addr == 0x2217B:\n            marker = \" &lt;&lt;&lt; 0x0162 entry\"\n        elif addr == 0x2218F:\n            marker = \" &lt;&lt;&lt; 0x0164 entry\"\n        print(f\"  0x{addr:05X}: {b:02X}{marker}\")\n    \n    print()\n    # Let me also check the dispatch table entries exactly for actions 0x0161 and 0x0162\n    # Table at file offset 0x4B058, each entry 6 bytes\n    TABLE_FILE = 0x4B058\n    \n    f.seek(0)\n    exe_data = f.read()\n    \n    for i in range(116):\n        off = TABLE_FILE + i * 6\n        action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', exe_data, off)[0]\n        stored_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', exe_data, off + 2)[0]\n        ghidra_addr = stored_ptr + 0x10000\n        \n        if 0x0160 &lt;= action_id &lt;= 0x0168:\n            print(f\"  Action 0x{action_id:04X} ({action_id}): stored=0x{stored_ptr:08X} -&gt; Ghidra=0x{ghidra_addr:05X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
